28. ARBITRATlON
Any dispute or difference arising out of or in connection with this Agreernent shall be settled by
arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 or any statutory modification
thereof for the time being in force anC shall be referred to the sole arbitrator norninated mutually by
the parties . The award given in arbitration shall be fin3l and binding on both the Parties to rhis
Agreement. The seat and venue of arbitration shall be Ahmedabad.
